test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
O, P, Q, R, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line facing the north. No one sits to the left of P. Only four people sit between P and Q. Only three people sit to the right of Y. X sits to the immediate left of R. W is not an immediate neighbour of Y.

Who sits third to the left of W?
solution:
**Given: **O, P, Q, R, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line facing the north.

1. No one sits to the left of P.

2. Only four people sit between P and Q.

3. Only three people sit to the right of Y.

4. X sits to the immediate left of R.

5. W is not an immediate neighbour of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b7112955c111c724ab901d8b2041ca26b16d848b95965b9bcb8f170b6d7dc51.png] 

O, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3318f1f04a57197e8f656cf1bdb97bd79b41e6fce589827061308368321ffdf.png] 

Thus, Y sits third to the left of W.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
